_about: Pureplay recipe. Starts the Pureplay launcher (it activates this PC's licence and installs updates), presses its PLAY button when it shows one, otherwise starts the game directly, and adds a Driving Range shortcut (Practice > Choose a range > Mountain Range > Start Range Session). The launcher installs per Windows account under %LOCALAPPDATA%; the game installs to Program Files. Tested with launcher 0.12.1194 / Unreal Engine 5.7 game build 20261112 (early access).
title: Golf Simulator
subtitle: Choose a simulator to start

beforeEachSim._note: Pureplay runs as the launcher (Pureplay Launcher, started by a small Pureplay.exe), plus the game, whose starter and actual game are both called Pureplaygolf.
beforeEachSim.label: Closing leftover sim apps

pureplayBoot._note: Pureplay.exe checks for launcher updates, then opens the launcher, which activates the licence. Without an active licence the game opens but ranges and courses refuse to load.
pureplayBoot.label: Starting the Pureplay launcher (licence and updates)

pureplayBoot._note: The launcher is an Electron app, so its button is pressed through UI Automation. It only offers PLAY once you're signed in to the launcher with a licensed account; until then this is skipped after 20 s and the next step starts the game directly.
pureplayBoot.label: Pressing Play in the launcher

pureplayRange._note: The game is Unreal Engine, so its menu is read with OCR. Wait for the menu first, so the next step only needs a quick look for the sign-in panel.
pureplayRange.label: Waiting for the menu

pureplayRange._note: With nobody in the party, Pureplay opens a 'Sign in here' panel (scan the QR code with your phone, or add a guest). This closes it if it's there; players can still join from the party button. Remove this step if you'd rather sign in on the panel each time.
pureplayRange.label: Closing the sign-in panel

pureplayRange._note: Pureplay can ignore the first click after it gets focus, and PRACTICE stays in the sidebar, so confirmText keeps clicking until the practice page shows.
pureplayRange.label: Opening Practice

pureplayRange._note: Swap in 'Floating Island Driving Range' (in both places below) for the fantasy range.
pureplayRange.label: Picking Mountain Range
